issue.title: Add Images & Maps Section to Resources Tab
issue.body: This ticket builds the Images & Maps section of the Resources tab, positioned at the bottom of the tab. Field testing showed strong response to this resource type, particularly for non-reader and low-literacy translators, so it covers thumbnail display, pinch-to-zoom, and full-screen viewing, along with the section's own error/retry handling when its content fails to load. ## Functional Requirements ### Images & Maps Section - Display Aquifer-sourced images and maps for the active unit at the bottom of the Resources tab. - Make the section itself a top-level accordion (li:chevron-down), collapsed by default, that the translator taps to reveal its contents. - Label the section "Images & Maps", with a photo stack icon (li:images) to the left of the title. - Show each item as a thumbnail with a title/caption and attribution. - Support pinch-to-zoom on every thumbnail, images and maps alike, since thumbnail labels are too small to read at default size. - Open a full-screen view (li:maximize) with pinch-to-zoom and pan when the translator taps a thumbnail. - Hide the section entirely when no images or maps are available for the unit. ### Error Handling - Show an inline error with a Retry button scoped to the Images & Maps section if its content fails to load. - Don't let an Images & Maps load failure block the Translation Notes or Translation Questions sections from displaying. --- ## Engineering context *(Added for implementation readiness. Product requirements above remain the source of truth.)* ### Product intent (summary) Show Aquifer images/maps at the bottom of Resources: accordion section, thumbnails with caption/attribution, pinch-zoom on thumbs, fullscreen maximize with pinch/pan, hide when empty, isolated error/retry. ### Proposed technical approach 1. `ImagesMapsSection` at bottom of Resources composition. 2. Load image metadata + local or remote URIs from resource store; prefer **local files** when #192/#201 have synced them. 3. Thumbnail grid/list with title/caption + attribution. 4. Pinch-zoom: use `react-native-gesture-handler` + suitable image zoom component (evaluate Expo-compatible libs via Expo docs when implementing). 5. Fullscreen modal/viewer on thumbnail tap (`maximize`); pinch + pan; dismiss control. 6. Independent error/retry from TN/TQ. ### Systems / modules / anchors - Host: `ResourcesTab` / #188 - Gestures: `react-native-gesture-handler` already in app stack - Filesystem: patterns from recording/`expo-file-system` once available for offline blobs - **No** Aquifer types/API/schema on `main` - Device QA required (gestures / fullscreen) ### Implementation steps 1. Agree Aquifer item model (id, title, attribution, localPath/remoteUrl, dimensions). 2. Section UI + thumbnails. 3. Inline pinch-zoom on thumbnail and fullscreen viewer. 4. Hide when empty; error+retry. 5. Automated tests for section chrome; **manual Android QA** for gestures. ### Dependencies & prerequisites - **In-repo:** #188; offline paths #192/#201 for zero-network viewing. Data layer shared with #189/#190. - **External:** Aquifer (or fluent-api proxy) asset URLs/metadata — mention only. ### Edge cases & failure states - Broken image URI: placeholder + keep caption; don’t crash viewer. - Very large images: downsample/cache thumbnails; avoid OOM. - Offline missing file: treat as unavailable for that item; section may still show others. - Attribution missing: show title only. ### Testing & verification - Component: hide empty, error isolation, opens fullscreen. - **Human Android device QA required** for pinch-zoom and fullscreen pan (AGENTS.md native/gesture bar). - CI gates for non-gesture logic. ### Analytics / observability / migrations - Cache/file inventory likely via #201; don’t fork a second image store. - Log image load failures with resource ids. ### Assumptions - “Maps” and “images” share the same viewer UX. - Live network fetch may be acceptable only until #192 enforces local-only — coordinate so #192 can turn off network reads. ### Open questions 1. Fluent-api vs direct Aquifer access from mobile? 2. Required attribution format/legal copy? 3. Max image dimensions / thumbnail generation strategy? ### Acceptance criteria - [ ] Images & Maps section at bottom of Resources when items exist; top-level accordion collapsed by default; “Images & Maps” + images icon. - [ ] Thumbnails show title/caption and attribution. - [ ] Pinch-to-zoom works on thumbnails; tap opens fullscreen with pinch-zoom and pan. - [ ] Section hidden when no items; section error + Retry does not block TN/TQ. - [ ] Android device QA recorded on the PR for zoom/fullscreen.

## API readiness note (board audit — refreshed)

**Why the API is not complete for this ticket**

Images & Maps need Aquifer (or proxied) **metadata + asset URLs** for the active unit, suitable for offline after Prepare Offline. fluent-api `main` still has **no Aquifer/images domain**. Mobile Resources UI still loads **mocks** (`imagesMapsMock.ts`).

### What exists today

- fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb`: only an editor-state preference string `activeResource: 'aquifer'` — not content.
- Mobile #295: Aquifer `searchResources` with `resourceType: 'Images'` is used when building Prepare Offline manifests; assets can be queued if URLs are present on Aquifer details.
- Resources tab Images & Maps section: **mock thumbnails**, not inventory/Aquifer-backed.

### What is missing

1. First-party fluent-api proxy/catalog for Aquifer images/maps (id, title, attribution, thumbnail/full URLs, sizes) — **or** documented approval for permanent direct Aquifer access from mobile.
2. Guaranteed offline file URIs in inventory keyed for Resources (#192/#201).
3. Attribution/legal fields normalized for UI.

### What needs to be done

1. fluent-api: Aquifer images proxy **or** formal “direct Aquifer” waiver with key management plan.
2. Mobile #191: replace mocks with inventory/Aquifer-backed loader once contract is clear; keep section error/retry isolation.
3. Coordinate with #192 so fullscreen/pinch viewers prefer local files after download.

Checked against fluent-api `main` @ `28f9bdb` (2026-08-06). Prior audit was `3ef4025` (2026-07-31).

Android only — no OTA.*

**Test Results: #191**

- Images & Maps are displayed at the bottom of the Resources tab.
- The Images & Maps section is collapsed by default.
- Tapping the chevron expands the section and displays the available images with thumbnails and titles.
- Users can open and view an image in full-screen mode.
- Users can pinch to zoom in and out and move the image in different directions.
- The image title is displayed correctly in full-screen mode.
- Users can exit full-screen mode by tapping the Close button or using the mobile Back button.
- Users can navigate between different verses, and the corresponding images are displayed correctly.


**Issues Identified**

- When the network connection is unavailable, "Images unavailable" is displayed, but there is no Retry option.
- The app crashes when the user tries to switch between users. Tapping the Settings icon results in an empty white screen.
